name: The Jury Experience: Death on the Port Side
description: An interactive courtroom drama where the audience is the jury and votes on the verdict in a fatal boat crash. In Portuguese, at Auditório Francisco de Assis on 28 November at 16:00 and 18:00. Tickets from €15.50.
longDescription:
The Jury Experience is a live courtroom drama in which the audience acts as the jury. In this case, a powerful politician's son was steering the family speedboat with his ex-girlfriend and old friends on board. Hours later, one of them was dead, another was in a coma, and the son is now charged with homicide.

During the show, you hear witness statements, look at the evidence and vote at key moments using your phone, so bring it with you to scan QR codes. At the end, the audience decides whether the accused is guilty or innocent. The show is performed in Portuguese.

The show is at Auditório Francisco de Assis, Rua do Amial 478, on Saturday 28 November 2026 at 16:00 and 18:00, and lasts 60 minutes. It's for ages 12 and up, and under-16s must come with an adult. It deals with domestic violence, emotional manipulation, alcohol use and a distressing emergency call. Tickets from €15.50.
